checks.name: deterministic repository-native implementation
checks.details: A real local manifest was generated with exact commit identity, pre-generation DIRTY state, authority-summary hash, tool version, controlled SHA-256 artifact references, and atomic FileMode.CreateNew output creation. It contains explicit non-release limitations and no source contents.

checks.name: zero-warning build
checks.details: The complete solution built with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

checks.name: static evidence source validation
checks.details: The source validator confirmed command exposure, deterministic identity handling, path checks, write-once output, secret-shaped output rejection, no-release boundary, test coverage, and local runbook.

checks.name: isolated functional regression
checks.details: The isolated temporary-repository harness passed success, byte-identical generation, Windows-separator deduplication, outside-path refusal, existing-output refusal, secret-shaped-output refusal, existing governance behavior, authority tamper detection, and safe fixture cleanup.

checks.name: repository secret boundary
checks.details: 341 files were inspected with no rule match. The secret-shaped negative test value is constructed only in the disposable fixture and is not present as a committed literal.

checks.name: authority and governance integrity
checks.command: tunner authority verify; tunner governance validate
checks.details: Authority verification returned VERIFIED for all 72 imported artifacts, and governance validation accepted 33 records with no diagnostics before final evidence records were added.

checks.name: context and diff hygiene
checks.command: tunner context build --work-item TUN-P0-011; tunner context verify; git diff --check
checks.details: The bounded P0-011 context pack was generated and verified current before final evidence records; the final refresh re-verifies this after evidence creation. No whitespace error was reported.

limitations: The generated local manifest is not committed evidence and does not approve a release, deployment, Product acceptance, or protected-main merge.
The tool intentionally records only selected repository paths and SHA-256 hashes; it cannot prove runtime behavior, external publication, or production state.
P0-011 remains subject to protected integration and the P0 enablement gate and therefore is not DONE.
